name: codex-guardian
description: Review proposed Codex actions with a local approval policy engine.

interface.shortDescription: Review proposed Codex actions before they run.
interface.longDescription: Codex Guardian adds a local policy reviewer for proposed Codex actions. It can return allow, ask_user, or decline decisions for file edits, shell commands, git operations, dependency installs, network access, and secret-sensitive paths.
defaultPrompt: Review this proposed Codex action with Codex Guardian.
Check whether this shell command should be allowed.
Decide whether this file edit should require user approval.
